candidate.feature_class: pre-registered molecular feature associated with developmental age
candidate.selection_rule: must be frozen before targeted perturbation and may not use outcome labels from the intervention arms

arms.baseline: old progenitors under the chosen heterochronic assay without candidate perturbation
arms.sham: matched nuisance intervention that preserves the candidate relation
arms.active: specific perturbation intended to weaken or remove the candidate relation
arms.restoration: pre-specified reversal or rescue intended to restore the candidate relation

oracle.independence: blinded to candidate standing and arm hypothesis
oracle.primary_endpoint: pre-registered fate outcome derived from donor-resolved cell identity
